exposure: Anteroposterior diameter of the pelvic inlet (APDI)
anteroposterior diameter of the pelvic outlet (APDO)
ratio of posterior sagittal diameter of the inlet to conjugata obstetrica
outcome: Labor types (normal vaginal delivery, caesarean section)
cohort: 165 healthy Turkish females aged between 18 and 45 years.
finding: The study found significant differences in various pelvic diameter measurements and the brim index across different pelvic types, with gynecoid being the most prevalent type (50.91%).
mod_finding: The android type pelvis was found to be inappropriate for natural labor, and only 7 females who delivered via cesarean had a gynecoid pelvic type.
